releaseStatus: Local feature-branch work only. Deployment, push, merge, indexing submissions and production database changes are NOT authorized by this task and were not performed.

architecture.framework: Next.js 16.3.4 App Router, React 19.3, TypeScript 6, Tailwind 4
architecture.hosting: Netlify; dynamic server-rendered HTML, cached public Supabase content, Next Image optimization
architecture.security: Per-response nonce CSP and private/no-store HTML preserved; no security relaxation for audit scores.
architecture.dependencies: No dependencies added, removed or upgraded; pnpm list --depth 0 resolves existing dependencies.

officialSources.application: Fundamentals and technical SEO learning paths inform the crawl, rendering and measurement audit; not a promise of rankings.
Useful visible content, descriptive links, canonical consistency and discoverable public pages.
Inspect initial HTML as well as rendered output, crawlable href links, metadata and meaningful 404 responses.
Ordinary SEO foundations also apply to AI search. No special AI schema or llms.txt indexing requirement was added. Indexing and inclusion are not guaranteed.
LCP <= 2500 ms, INP <= 200 ms and CLS <= 0.1 are targets. Local Lighthouse TBT is not field INP.

fixes.issue: The poster maker was absent from the analytics-safe path list and successful exports had no measurement.
fixes.change: Add consent-gated poster_export with allowlisted design, format and language only; allow the poster-maker and existing double-exposure guide paths; extend the privacy disclosure. Names, contact fields, greeting text, filenames, uploads and export bytes are excluded.

fixes.issue: Sitemap lastmod omitted maintained public FAQ revisions included in prompt page schema; string sorting was unsafe for mixed timestamp offsets.
fixes.change: Share an instant-aware modification-date helper between prompt structured data and sitemap generation. Preserve newer static-page dates. Update the poster-maker revision for this substantive page edit.

fixes.issue: The poster maker's heading did not name the tool, and visitors lacked direct routes back to its three artwork prompts and published festival guide.
fixes.change: Add a descriptive H1, breadcrumbs and relevant server-rendered links to eligible published templates, the collection and related guide. Optional recommendation-data failure does not disable the browser editor.

fixes.issue: The homepage LCP image had no high fetch priority; detail image sizes overstated its actual CSS width.
fixes.change: Use the wrapper's eager/high-priority image mode instead of preload alone. Match detail sizes to the existing responsive grid without changing original image quality or bytes.

fixes.issue: Provider links displayed Open Tool while accessible labels named the provider, causing a Lighthouse label/content mismatch.
fixes.change: Make the visible link name include its provider, retaining the existing target, rel, ordinary-link disclosure and consent-gated tracking.

fixes.issue: Missing pages returned real 404s but contained both index and noindex metadata.
fixes.change: Give the shared not-found page explicit noindex metadata and a distinctive title. Regression tests verify exhausted pagination and missing resources remain 404 with no conflicting index directive.

sharedTemplates: Reel listing/detail implementation and existing metadata tests
Protected admin and private blog preview boundaries
verifiedFoundations: Important public text, headings, href links, canonicals and metadata are in server-rendered HTML; no framework migration needed.
All 135 current public page-sitemap URLs resolve locally to 200, self-canonical, indexable pages using read-only public Supabase content.
Pagination retains crawlable links and distinct self-canonicals without JavaScript; tracking parameters do not enter canonical URLs.
Host aliases and trailing slashes redirect to established canonical destinations in the local production server.
Search/saved/admin/preview routes are noindex or unavailable; 89 drafts remain outside discovery and sitemaps. Deploy-preview/branch-deploy indexing guards remain intact.
Existing CreativeWork, Article, FAQ and breadcrumb data is retained with visible supporting content; no fabricated reviews, ratings or AI-specific schema.
Public prompt identity guidance, tool limitations and historical evidence disclosures remain intact. No template or article was auto-published.

validation.unit: 326 Vitest tests across 52 files plus 9 mocked IndexNow tests passed; no IndexNow submission performed.
validation.content: 193 local records, 17 categories, 40 collections; zero missing images. 104 published / 89 drafts preserved. SEO check: 102 eligible prompts, zero errors, 47 editorial review notices.
validation.releaseContent: Existing release, festival and blog validation scripts passed. Seven seed articles deliberately remain drafts; local browser QA reads the seven already-published production articles without writes.
validation.build: Next production webpack build passed (159 generated build entries). Separate local builds used analytics disabled for lab comparison and synthetic G-TEST12345 with Google stubs for consent tests. No real analytics test visits sent.
validation.browser: 92 distinct read-only desktop/mobile scenarios passed across final runs, including final 30/30 search/analytics/privacy checks. The new suite also passed 9/9 against unchanged local seed data. Twelve existing isolated affiliate-suite scenarios were skipped by their safety guard; no admin database-write journey was run.
validation.browserDetails: No hydration/page errors or horizontal overflow in sampled templates; axe checks passed. Copy, search, save, keyboard controls, image failure, all poster formats/designs, Hindi, uploads, overflow, reset, export failures, privacy and consent withdrawal checked.
validation.testCorrections: Corrected audit-test expectations for root canonical normalization, JavaScript-disabled DOM readiness and queue clearing on consent-revocation reload. A Playwright trace-close transport error did not reproduce in the final rerun.
validation.privateEvidence: .release-private/search-quality-20261011/ and ignored Playwright output; no raw browser evidence or private exports staged.

performance.method: Installed Lighthouse, six representative routes, mobile and desktop, local production build, Google services blocked. Single-run diagnostics are noisy; not field data or a causal ranking claim. No INP claim from TBT.
performance.comparison: See lab-summary.json generated from the private baseline and candidate diagnostics.
performance.candidate: Desktop performance 100 on all six routes; mobile 95–98. SEO/accessibility 100 and CLS 0 on all samples. Mobile LCP: home 2984 ms, men 2950 ms, portrait 2410 ms, collection 2408 ms, article 2571 ms, editor 2206 ms. Home/category/article still exceed the 2500 ms target in this run.
performance.interpretation: The missing homepage high-priority hint and detail oversized-image diagnostic are resolved. Detail desktop transfer falls from 332680 to 324793 bytes. Single-run LCP varies in both directions (including a slower article sample); this is not sufficient evidence of causal speed improvement or regression. Repeated local/field measurements remain necessary.

Review the 47 similarity/shared-preview notices by intent, not text percentage. Shared identity instructions and photo-versus-reel pairs inflate lexical overlap. Obtain real, permitted tool-test evidence before claiming verified results; do not mass-rewrite, delete or publish drafts.

Continue measured mobile image/network optimization where local LCP exceeds 2.5 seconds. Preserve quality and CSP. Search Console has no field data yet; collect consented measurements before asserting field gains.
After an approved release, verify poster_export in authorized GA4 reports and decide whether to mark it as a key event. GA4 account/report configuration was not accessed or changed.
